LightningComponentBundle.description: Unified Massey customer view: pest service history, Property Asset states (bait stations, soil temp, conducive conditions), recent Cases, recent Work Orders by service line, and upsell history (Last_Upsell_Service_Line__c, Last_Upsell_Outcome__c, Upsell_Score__c). Used on the Service Console (Account) and embedded in the massey-portal Experience Cloud site.
